basic_details.scholarship_name: Tsinghua University Chinese Government & Tuition Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: China Scholarship Council (CSC, Ministry of Education PRC) in partnership with Tsinghua University (Beijing, China)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Tsinghua University Main Campus (Haidian District, Beijing, China)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all international graduate programs with distinguished excellence in Computer Science and Technology (CS, AI, Computer Systems), Electronic Engineering, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and School of Materials Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 150 to 200 international full graduate scholarships awarded across university departments annually (CSC Type B High-Level Postgraduate Program)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in computer science and engineering have strong representation (typically 12 to 20 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 to 3 years for Master degree; 4 years for PhD degree, subject to passing annual CSC scholarship review

nationality_requirements: Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport in good health
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Master applicants must be under 35 years of age; Doctoral applicants must be under 40 years of age by September 1 of enrollment year.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor degree (16 years education) for Master applicants; completed Master degree (18 years education) for PhD applicants from an HEC-recognized university with outstanding academic standing (minimum 3.60 / 4.00 CGPA or 82%+ aggregate from leading Pakistani institutions like NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, LUMS).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Consistent 1st Division / Grade A across secondary and post-secondary educational credentials required.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Strong undergraduate or postgraduate foundation in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or closely related engineering fields.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final year graduating students eligible; must provide official Certificate of Expected Graduation issued by home university and submit original degree before registration.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of degree conferral provided age requirements are fulfilled.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory. Research publications in premier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, IEEE/ACM) or strong open-source repositories significantly improve doctoral prospects.

english_proficiency.notes: Official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university accepted for English-taught graduate programs; IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 85 score report recommended for top ranking.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Chinese language proficiency (HSK Level 4/5) required ONLY for Chinese-taught degree programs. Zero Chinese language proficiency required for English-taught graduate programs.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Outstanding postgraduate researchers in advanced computing, AI, and engineering.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be a concurrent recipient of any other Chinese government, provincial, or university scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition exemption (CNY 30,000 to 40,000 / year waived completely across full degree duration).
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~CNY 30,000 to 40,000 / year value; ~PKR 1,200,000 to 1,600,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Tsinghua University online application processing fee (CNY 800) is paid directly by applicant.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus accommodation provided in Tsinghua Zijing International Student Apartments (single room for PhD, shared double for Master); or monthly housing subsidy of CNY 700 to 1,000/month if living off-campus.
accommodation.amount: Free campus dormitory (~CNY 1,200 / month value; ~PKR 48,000 / mo)

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid by CSC: CNY 3,000/month for Master's students (~PKR 120,000/month); CNY 3,500/month for PhD students (~PKR 140,000/month), often supplemented by professor lab RA top-ups of CNY 1,000 to 3,000/month.
monthly_stipend.amount: CNY 36,000 to 42,000 / year CSC base (~PKR 1,440,000 to 1,680,000 / year)

airfare.details: Initial flight to Beijing and return airfare upon graduation are self-funded by the student.

visa_fee.details: Chinese X1 student visa application fee and residence permit medical checkups paid by student in Islamabad/Karachi and Beijing.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Medical Insurance and Protection Scheme for Foreign Students in China (Ping An Insurance, CNY 800/year covered by CSC).

food_allowance.details: Subsidized Tsinghua campus dining halls provide delicious meals at very low cost (~CNY 15 to 25/day; ~PKR 1,000/day).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Advanced computing clusters, GPU nodes, and laboratory experimental consumables funded by Tsinghua faculty grants.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Tsinghua Graduate School and faculty research grants sponsor international conference travel for students with accepted papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Beijing subway and campus electric bike/bicycle transit are self-funded.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single world-leading institution: Tsinghua University (Beijing, China)
participating_institutions: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School (Tsinghua SIGS, Shenzhen)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ranked #1 university in Asia and #12 worldwide in QS World University Rankings. Department of Computer Science ranked among global top 5.
available_majors: Department of Computer Science and Technology: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, High Performance Computing
Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS / Yao Class): Theoretical Computer Science, Quantum Information
Department of Electronic Engineering: Information and Communication Engineering, Microelectronics
Department of Automation: Control Science and Engineering, Pattern Recognition
School of Materials Science and Engineering: Materials Physics, Nanotechnology
Global Environmental Program & Civil and Environmental Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master degree: 2 to 3 years; PhD degree: 4 years full-time research residency.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's in relevant discipline with 3.6+ GPA, prospective professor acceptance letter strongly recommended, 2 recommendation letters, personal statement, and official transcripts.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Department of Computer Science and IIIS are among the most selective programs in the world; Shenzhen International Graduate School (SIGS) and Materials Science offer slightly higher acceptance margins.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Obtaining a preliminary acceptance letter (Form for Provisional Acceptance of International Student by Tsinghua Professor) dramatically increases chances of receiving both university admission and CSC Type B full scholarship nomination. Reach out to faculty in September/October.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Tsinghua University Graduate Admissions System & CSC Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register account on Tsinghua Graduate Admissions System, complete profile, choose scholarship preference (CSC / Tsinghua Tuition Scholarship), and simultaneously complete CSC portal application under Tsinghua Agency Number (10003).
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - October): Review faculty research profiles; contact prospective professors with CV, transcripts, and research proposal to secure Form for Provisional Acceptance.
Step 2 (Mid-October): Register on Tsinghua University Graduate Admissions System (gradadmission.tsinghua.edu.cn) and fill out application forms.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload all required documents, pay application fee (CNY 800), and submit application.
Step 4 (December - January): Fill out Chinese Government Scholarship application on CSC portal (studyinchina.csc.edu.cn) selecting Type B and Agency Number 10003.
Step 5 (January - March): Tsinghua departmental faculty committee reviews application files, shortlists candidates, and conducts technical video interviews.
Step 6 (April - May): Department submits nominated scholarship candidate list to Tsinghua Graduate School and CSC for final validation.
Step 7 (June - July): Official admission results and CSC scholarship letters released; university dispatches Admission Notice and JW201/JW202 visa forms.
Step 8 (July - August): Apply for Chinese X1 Student Visa at Chinese Embassy/Consulate in Pakistan; book flights to Beijing.
Step 9 (Late August / Early September): Campus arrival in Beijing, dormitory check-in, residence permit registration, and semester orientation.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated nomination (CSC Type B): Tsinghua University directly selects and nominates admitted international students to the China Scholarship Council for full funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters submitted online via referee email invitation link generated by Tsinghua admissions portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal Statement & Research Plan: Detail academic accomplishments, research interests, career aspirations, and rationale for choosing Tsinghua University (minimum 1,000 words).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research proposal (1,500 to 2,000 words) detailing literature background, research objectives, methodology, and expected results.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing educational history, GPA, programming languages, research projects, publications, and awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Comprehensive 20 to 30 minute video interview conducted via Tencent Meeting / Zoom by a departmental faculty committee evaluating fundamental knowledge, research competence, and English communication.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 85 recommended; English MOI certificate accepted. GRE optional.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC Pakistan attestation required on degrees and transcripts, followed by Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan attestation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Notarized English or Chinese translations for any documents not in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via Tsinghua Graduate Admissions online portal and CSC portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color scan of passport bio-data page valid for at least one year beyond admission date.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure Pakistani machine-readable passport bio page is scanned in high resolution.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Bachelor's and/or Master's degree certificates and complete academic transcripts.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by Higher Education Commission (HEC) and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Statement of Purpose and Research Plan
required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive 1,000 to 1,500 word statement detailing academic background and proposed research.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Demonstrate clear alignment with Tsinghua faculty research directions.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Signed recommendation letters from Associate Professors or Full Professors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be on institutional letterhead with official academic email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official standard Chinese Foreigner Physical Examination Form with hospital stamp, doctor signature, and attached lab reports.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Completed at any recognized tertiary government hospital in Pakistan within 6 months prior to submission.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official Police Character Certificate issued within the past 6 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by local Pakistani Police Khidmat Markaz and attested by MOFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS / TOEFL scorecard or English Medium of Instruction certificate.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: MOI certificate signed and stamped by university registrar or controller of examinations.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Form for Provisional Acceptance by Tsinghua Professor (Optional but Recommended)
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official signed provisional acceptance form from Tsinghua faculty member.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Drastically boosts chances of selection when uploaded in application portal.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Round 1 (October to January) is strongly recommended for CSC and university scholarship consideration.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA, academic transcript rigor, and university prestige)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Research publications, thesis quality, project portfolio, and technical competence)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Software development, tech industry internships, or research assistantships)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of vision, intellectual depth, and research feasibility)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee, prospective faculty advisor, and Tsinghua Graduate School Admissions Office.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Comprehensive dossier evaluation: Departmental admissions committee reviews GPA, research publications, and letters of recommendation. Top candidates are invited for an online technical video interview. Selected applicants are nominated to Tsinghua Graduate School and China Scholarship Council for full scholarship funding.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 5,000 international applicants across all disciplines
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~150 to 200 fully funded CSC Type B and Tsinghua scholarships
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~8.0% (Higher for top Pakistani CS/engineering graduates with publications and professor acceptance)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Outstanding academic record, 1+ indexed conference/journal publications, strong coding/math foundations, and preliminary acceptance letter from Tsinghua professor.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: BS/MS graduates in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, and Electrical Engineering from NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, and LUMS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Russia, South Korea, Malaysia, Thailand, Germany, France, USA

fake_websites_and_scams: Fraudulent agencies demanding money for guaranteed CSC scholarships at Tsinghua. Tsinghua does not work with commercial agents; all applications must be submitted directly via official portals.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Tsinghua charges a standard non-refundable application fee of CNY 800 paid directly in the admissions portal. Never pay fees to private individuals.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Applications submitted through third-party agents or containing templated personal statements are flagged and rejected.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Medical examination and police character certificate attestation (~PKR 20,000 - 30,000).
Chinese residence permit and health check upon arrival in Beijing (~CNY 800 to 1,000; ~PKR 32,000 to 40,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: HSK Chinese language certificate is required for all majors. (FACT: Dozens of graduate programs in computing, engineering, and sciences are 100% English-taught).
CLAIM: HEC Pakistan nomination is required for Tsinghua CSC Type B. (FACT: Tsinghua CSC Type B is direct university recommendation; no HEC nomination needed).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Commercial blogs claim CSC covers flight tickets; official CSC regulations confirm round-trip international airfare is NOT covered for general university recommendation scholars.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic standing (GPA >= 3.0 / 4.0) and pass the mandatory Annual CSC Scholarship Review conducted every April/May.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residency on campus and active participation in laboratory research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual comprehensive evaluation covering coursework, research output, and laboratory supervisor endorsement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is restricted under Chinese student visa laws; on-campus TA/RA positions are permitted with department approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. Scholars are free to pursue doctoral, postdoctoral, or industry careers globally or in China upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or financial return requirements.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is suspended or cancelled if student fails annual review, withdraws, or commits disciplinary infractions; past disbursements are not reclaimed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing universities is strictly prohibited under CSC scholarship regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing majors is generally not permitted except under exceptional circumstances approved by the Graduate School and CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship extensions are extremely rare and granted only with special approval from CSC and Tsinghua Graduate School for compelling academic reasons.
